steps.content: You guys won, but Ted's men are still beating up the defeated opponents with bloodshot eyes and fatal blows.

steps.speaker: Ted's Men
steps.content: Haha, you dare to rob us... Die—Die—Die!!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Stop! I *** defeated them! Who gave you permission to beat him up? GET—OFF—!!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: *** Where did they get their strength from? Can't even pull them away.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: They are out of control and got Mania. Did they get affected because they're near SALVA?

options: Tell Ted's men to leave. It's dangerous.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: No, we can't miss this chance.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: SALVA is only guarded by some armed doctors. We won't be able to take down this place when the woman comes back...

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: My men may be infected with Mania... but they also gained power. See? They killed Gonzales with their bare hands!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What? If you care about your men, stop letting them take any more risks.

steps.speaker: Ted
steps.content: I can't stop here after fighting for this long and losing so many men. This is my last chance. My men have become stronger and still standing in the fight. We are so close...
At this moment, SALVA's tightly-shut door finally opened. A group of armed doctors walked out with stern faces, or rather, with cold abhorrence.

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: Stupid gangsters... You dare to attack SALVA. You must have lost your minds.

steps.speaker: SALVA Doctor
steps.content: Dr. Iron will treat you guys. Let's sterilize before she comes back.
